evidence_policy.mean_required: rolling or expanding-window historical out-of-sample forecast accuracy by position and forecast horizon
evidence_policy.uncertainty_required: archived forecast residual calibration and held-out interval/distribution coverage by position and forecast horizon
evidence_policy.promotion_rule: A challenger may replace the incumbent only when it improves pre-specified temporal holdout metrics without material calibration or coverage degradation.

mean.source: current external season projection transformed under FSFFL scoring

uncertainty.source: historical realized weekly scoring dispersion plus bounded heuristics
known_runtime_assumptions: minimum player-game and position-game sample gates
player CV shrinkage toward position CV with capped sample weight
Normal outcome shape for percentile construction
median offset from mean by a fixed fraction of weekly SD

required_versioned_artifacts_for_promoti: historical forecast snapshots with as-of timestamps
candidate and incumbent metrics by position and horizon
promotion decision with immutable model/config version
blocked_reason: The repository contains rich realized historical scoring, but the governance audit has not detected archived contemporaneous historical projection snapshots sufficient to estimate forecast residuals without look-ahead bias.
